subject: Procurement kickoff: onboarding evidence & PO prerequisites
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@helixtx.com>
Cc: procurement@helixtx.com
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement kickoff: onboarding evidence & PO prerequisites

Hi Liam —

Thanks for starting the vendor setup conversation. A few quick notes to get us moving:

1) Attached is our vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx for your AP and legal teams to complete (company info, remit, tax requirements, contact list).
2) Per your procurement checklist, please confirm which specific security artifacts you need before issuing a PO — common asks are: SOC 2 Type II report (latest period), ISO 27001 certificate, and a pen-test attestation/summary. We can provide summaries publicly and full SOC 2 under NDA.
3) Do you require any notarized copies or third-party attestation letters? If so, call that out and we will prioritize.
4) PO format: please confirm whether your PO number must include a specific prefix and whether Helix requires a signed SOW before PO.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm required documents and timelines
- We drop the requested docs into a shared Drive link and route an NDA if needed
- Evelyn (cc'd) will confirm report dates and the level of detail for pen-test evidence

Attaching: vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx (fillable).

Thanks — looking forward to a quick turnaround so your team can issue the PO.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@helixtx.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Helix AP <ap@helixtx.com>, procurement@helixtx.com
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement kickoff: onboarding evidence & PO prerequisites

Hi Dylan —

Thanks for the form. Quick answers from Helix procurement: we will need the latest SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certificate, plus a pen-test attestation that states scope and date. We typically accept a one-page attestation from the vendor's security team if the full pen test report is restricted.

Two questions:
- Will the SOC 2 be full report or an executive summary? We prefer full report under NDA but can accept summary in some cases.
- Do you have a standard DPA or do we need to circulate ours (I can send it if you prefer)?

AP also asked: do you accept the following remit and PO format? PO prefix HELIX- followed by numeric. Remit instructions will be included in the completed onboarding form.

I attached Helix_vendor_security_qs_v1.xlsx — it's short and helps our security team triage what they need.

Regards,
Liam O'Connor
Procurement Manager 
Helix Therapeutics
liam.oconnor@helixtx.com | +1 (212) 555-0199

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@helixtx.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement kickoff: onboarding evidence & PO prerequisites

Thanks Liam — good questions.

On the SOC 2: we can provide the SOC 2 Type II report via NDA (full report) or a short summary that covers control scope and period. Evelyn, can you confirm the most recent report date and whether we have a redacted summary we can drop immediately?

On ISO: we have a current ISO 27001 certificate (scanned PDF) — attaching the certificate to this thread (ISO27001_certificate_redwood.pdf).

On pen test: Redwood commissions annual third-party tests. We typically provide a signed attestation/overview (pen_test_attestation_redwood.pdf) that lists scope, testing vendor, and the date. Full pen test reports are sensitive but can be shared under tight NDAs or MSA addenda.

DPA: we have a standard DPA; happy to review Helix's DPA if you prefer to circulate yours. Karthik — please advise on commercial cadence (SOW first vs. PO first) for this account and whether Helix requires a signed SOW before AP issues HELIX- POs.

I'll upload the SOC2 summary and the other artifacts to the shared Drive link and send a DocuSign NDA link if you confirm you'd like the full SOC report.

Attachments: ISO27001_certificate_redwood.pdf (attached placeholder).

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference

Hi Liam and Dylan —

Following up with the security-specific details:

- SOC 2 Type II: Report period 2025-07 through 2026-06. We can provide an executive summary immediately (SOC2_Redwood_TypeII_summary.pdf attached). Full SOC 2 report is available under NDA / data room access.
- ISO 27001: Certificate ID: RW-ISO-27001-2024. Certificate was issued 2024-09-03, current through 2027-09-02.
- Pen test: Performed 2026-02-11 by RedwoodSec Labs. We provide a signed pen-test attestation that summarizes scope (external web app + customer-facing APIs) and high-level results; full report is restricted. Pen test summary attached (pen_test_attestation_redwood.pdf).

If Helix security needs more granular artifacts we can run an NDA and provide redacted excerpts or arrange a controlled read-only session with our security team. We can also schedule a 30-minute triage call this week to walk through the onboarding checklist.

For the DPA question: our standard DPA is compatible with most enterprise buyers; happy to review Helix's DPA in parallel.

Dylan / Evelyn —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the attachments. The SOC 2 summary and pen-test attestation look fine for our initial review. A couple of items before AP issues a PO:

- Helix AP requires a vendor tax form on file (W-9 for US entities). Could you provide the appropriate tax form or EU equivalent?
- We will circulate our standard SOW via DocuSign (link below). We typically issue the PO (HELIX-#####) 7-14 business days after receiving the required evidence and a completed onboarding form.

DocuSign SOW (Helix standard): https://docusign.com/helix/sow/4521
Drive link where you can upload evidence: https://drive.helixtx.com/shared/DEAL-9321/evidence (please upload final PDFs).

If you can upload the W-9 and the full SOC 2 under NDA by next Tuesday, we should be able to have AP issue the PO within the two-week window.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this quickly.

Regards,
Liam O'Connor
Procurement Manager | Helix Therapeutics
